title: Senior Technical Lead / Architect
jobDescription:
Senior Technical Lead / Architect

We are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking Senior Technical Lead / Architect to drive the design, evolution, and delivery of our enterprise-grade software systems. In this role, you will serve as the technical anchor of one or more product squads - guiding engineers, defining architectural standards, and translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions.
You will work closely with product, infrastructure, and data teams to establish best practices across the full software delivery lifecycle. You are equally comfortable whiteboarding system designs with architects as you are reviewing pull requests with developers. Your technology background is broad and stack-agnostic; what matters most is your depth of engineering judgement and your passion for building systems that last.

Key Responsibilities:

Architecture & Design
Lead end-to-end architecture for new products, platforms, and major feature initiatives
Define and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, and coding standards across teams
Evaluate build vs. buy decisions and drive technology selection with clear rationale
Produce architectural decision records (ADRs) and ensure documentation stays current
Design for non-functional requirements: scalability, resilience, observability, and security by design

Technical Leadership
Provide hands-on technical mentorship to senior, mid, and junior engineers
Conduct architecture and code reviews with constructive, knowledge-sharing feedback
Collaborate with product owners to refine technical feasibility, effort estimates, and trade-off analysis
Act as the primary technical point of contact for cross-team and cross-functional initiatives

Cloud & Infrastructure
Design and govern cloud-native architectures on AWS, Azure, and/or GCP (multi-cloud awareness is a
plus)
Define cloud cost optimisation strategies - right-sizing, reserved capacity, and FinOps principles
Ensure architectures leverage managed services, serverless patterns, and auto-scaling where
appropriate
Drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC) adoption using tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or CDK

Database Engineering

Design and own relational (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis,
Cassandra) schemas
Lead database performance optimisation: query tuning, indexing strategies, execution plan analysis,
and caching layers
Define data security controls: encryption at rest and in transit, field-level masking, RBAC, and audit
logging
Govern data lifecycle policies, backup/recovery strategies, and disaster recovery testing
Evaluate and introduce new storage technologies aligned to specific workload demands

DevOps & Developer Experience

Champion CI/CD pipeline design, branching strategies, and automated testing gates
Containerise applications using Docker and oversee Kubernetes / ECS / Cloud Run deployment models
Promote shift-left security (SAST, DAST, dependency scanning) within the development workflow
Establish SLOs, error budgets, and observability practices using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana,
Datadog, or equivalent

AI & Emerging Technologies (Advantageous)

Contribute architectural guidance to AI/ML-powered product features or internal tooling
Evaluate and integrate LLM APIs, embedding pipelines, RAG architectures, or fine-tuning workflows
Ensure responsible AI practices - model governance, bias evaluation, and data privacy compliance
Stay current with the AI landscape and identify opportunities to embed intelligent capabilities into
products

Show Less

Preferred Skills

Core Engineering Experience

8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a technical lead or
architect capacity
Proficiency in one or more languages: JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js), Python, Java, C# (.NET), or Go
Solid grasp of OOP, functional programming, design patterns (SOLID, DDD, CQRS, Event Sourcing), and
clean code principles
Extensive experience designing RESTful and GraphQL APIs; familiarity with gRPC and async messaging
(Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS)
Proven track record of delivering large-scale distributed systems in production environments

Cloud Platforms (at least one, multi-cloud awareness preferred)
[AWS] [Azure] [Google Cloud Platform]
Deep hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider
Core service familiarity: compute (EC2/VMs/GCE), containers (EKS/AKS/GKE), serverless, object
storage, CDN, VPC/networking
Understanding of IAM, least-privilege access, secrets management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Key
Vault)
Experience with cloud cost management, tagging strategies, and rightsizing

Database Skills (MANDATORY)
[Schema Design] [Query Optimisation] [Indexing] [Security] [DR & Backup]

Strong relational database design skills - normalisation, referential integrity, schema versioning
(Flyway, Liquibase)
Performance tuning: EXPLAIN/ANALYZE, index design, covering indexes, partitioning, connection
pooling
NoSQL data modelling for document stores, key-value, wide-column, and time-series databases
Database security: row-level security, column masking, audit trails, encryption key management
High-availability configurations: read replicas, failover clusters, cross-region replication

DevOps & Containerisation (Minimum Proficiency Required)
[Docker] [CI/CD] [IaC] [Kubernetes (basic)]
Container fundamentals: Dockerfile best practices, multi-stage builds, image hardening, registry
management
CI/CD pipeline configuration in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins
Infrastructure as Code basics with Terraform or equivalent
Familiarity with Kubernetes concepts (deployments, services, config maps, ingress) - deep expertise is
a plus

Soft Skills & Leadership
Exceptional communication - able to translate technical concepts for both engineering teams and
non-technical stakeholders
Strong analytical and systems-thinking approach to problem decomposition
Experience driving technical roadmaps aligned with business goals and product strategy
Comfortable operating in fast-paced, agile environments with shifting priorities
Collaborative, empathetic leadership style with a focus on team growth and knowledge transfer

NICE TO HAVE (ADVANTAGEOUS)

Prior experience contributing to or leading AI/ML-powered products or platforms
Hands-on work with LLM frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI API, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, or
Bedrock
Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector) and semantic search architectures
MLOps experience: model deployment, versioning, monitoring, and retraining pipelines
Knowledge of data engineering patterns - streaming (Kafka, Kinesis), batch ETL, and data
lake/warehouse architectures
Relevant cloud certifications: AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google
Professional Cloud Architect
Experience in regulated industries (FinTech, HealthTech, GovTech) with compliance awareness (GDPR,
ISO 27001, SOC 2)
Open-source contributions or active participation in technical communities

descriptionFromApi:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.

As a part of The Brandtech Group , were at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.

Role: Design Lead

Location: Mumbai, India

About the role:

Working in true collaboration with our client, we have one goal in mind: to be the leading agency partner for the development of stunning and effective needs based content and digital media campaigns .

We want to create industry-leading, world class work that s truly beautiful, smart, and effective. To help us achieve our goal, we are looking for a strong, highly motivated and conceptual designer who understands the aesthetics of scientifically inclined skincare brands, preferably having worked with such brands in the recent past.

These brands are at the forefront of contemporary thinking, utilising in depth insight for digital strategy and content advertising. They are also dedicated to sustainability and foregrounding a brand purpose, which means the work we do with them requires working creative thinking into every brief, regardless of scale.

As Design Lead you will be an experienced digitally focused designer, comfortable leading design projects from brief through to completion, providing new ideas and creativity whilst working closely with the client s brand guidelines. You will be producing design to the client s brief and exacting standards whilst positively influencing clients with your creative input in addition to undertaking and pitching new creative concepts. You will be expected to work on a range of creatives from e-commerce to social media, bringing simplicity in design to the most complex briefs.

What you will be doing:

  • Producing beautiful and innovative designs for our client s websites, e-commerce (A+ and Shopalyst) pages and social media channels.
  • To be responsible for the full design lifecycle from concept to execution.
  • To develop a deep understanding of target audiences and the client s marketing strategy to deliver high quality results that have an instant, positive impact on the consumer, promoting products and brands.
  • To pitch creative solutions in response to marketing strategies.
  • To oversee and manage the preparation of all finished files that will comply with the correct output specifications.

What you need to be great in this role:

  • Looking for someone with 6 to 8 years of experience.
  • Excellent Adobe CS skills.
  • Understanding of design principles and an awareness of UX, UI and Responsive Design trends - it is ideal but not essential.
  • Expertise in beauty and skincare brands
  • Working knowledge of After Effects animation is a bonus.
  • Effectively organising and prioritising workloads to manage client delivery whilst simultaneously influencing clients with your own ideas and conceptual creativity.

Job Summary

As a Senior Technical Consultant (Shift Lead) in the Shared Data/ODSP Factory, you will lead on-shift technical delivery for tenant-to-tenant migrations of collaboration content across Microsoft 365, typically SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business and associated Teams/M365 Group content structures. You will run a controlled, metrics-driven migration factory, ensuring runbooks are executed consistently, migrations are scheduled and monitored, permissions/metadata fidelity is validated and defects are remediated efficiently. You will be accountable for shift throughput, quality gates, evidence capture and operational reporting while coordinating escalations and ensuring seamless handovers across the 24x7 model.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical execution of SharePoint/OneDrive/ODSP migration waves during your shift, ensuring runbook adherence and predictable throughput.
  • Own shift triage for failures (throttling, permissions mapping issues, blocked files, metadata/versioning exceptions, large list/library constraints, URL/path constraints).
  • Validate readiness: source/target access, migration accounts/consents, pre-checks, quota constraints and cutover schedule alignment.
  • Configure, schedule and monitor migration jobs using the approved toolset (native and/or third-party), proactively identifying risks before they become wave blockers.
  • Enforce quality gates: sampling/validation outcomes, permission parity checks, metadata fidelity and user experience verification.
  • Maintain operational control of the shift backlog and prioritise tasks based on cutover plans, dependencies and SLA.
  • Produce and manage evidence packs per wave: migration reports, exception logs, remediation records, sign-off artefacts and audit trail completeness.
  • Coordinate handovers with clear exceptions, blockers and next actions; ensure continuity of long-running migration jobs across shifts.
  • Drive continuous improvement: update runbooks, known error catalogues and operational dashboards; reduce recurring failures and rework.
  • Manage escalations (vendor support, platform support pathways, programme technical leadership) with complete diagnostic context and clear asks.

Requirements

  • Delivered at least one production tenant-to-tenant migration of SharePoint Online and/or OneDrive (ODSP) content as a senior SME/lead.
  • Deep expertise in SharePoint Online/OneDrive architecture concepts relevant to migration: site structures, permissions models, sharing/links, metadata/versioning, information architecture constraints.
  • Hands-on experience with migration tooling in this space (e.g., ShareGate and/or Quest ODM or equivalent) and the ability to run migrations at scale.
  • Proven ability to run migration operations in a factory model: scheduling, monitoring, exception handling and quality gates at high volume.
  • Strong understanding of security/compliance impacts in migrated content (sensitivity labels/retention behaviours where applicable; access governance, least privilege).
  • Strong runbook discipline and evidence capture practice; comfortable being held to audit standards for every wave.

Good-to-Have

  • Experience migrating Teams-associated content dependencies (files in SharePoint, OneDrive artefacts linked to user data used by collaboration features) and coordinating sequencing.
  • Familiarity with multi-geo considerations and URL/domain nuances that can impact migration execution.
  • Microsoft certifications relevant to Microsoft 365 administration (e.g., MS-102) or SharePoint specialization, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience using PowerShell/Graph for reporting, bulk checks, or automation around migration readiness and validation.
  • Knowledge of data governance, information architecture and content lifecycle management in Microsoft 365.

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills

  • Keeps shift teams focused on plan and standards; prevents uncontrolled variation in execution.
  • Communicates clearly with upstream/downstream disciplines (Identity, Teams, Adoption, Security) to manage dependencies and unblock progress.
  • Escalates early and responsibly with evidence; avoids late surprises.
  • Coaches engineers to solve problems systematically (root cause, pattern recognition, runbook refinement).
  • Strong stakeholder communication habits suitable for a major programme: concise, factual, action-oriented updates.
  • Builds trust through calm leadership during cutovers and operational incidents.

Typical Deliverables / KPIs

  • Throughput: sites/OneDrives migrated per shift; data volume migrated vs plan.
  • Defect rate: percentage of migrations requiring re-run; recurring exception types reduced over time.
  • MTTR: resolution time for migration blockers and priority incidents.
  • Evidence capture: percentage of waves with complete exportable reports and sign-off records.
  • SLA: scheduled cutovers achieved on time with managed risk and exceptions logged.

Shift / Working Pattern Notes

This role operates within a three-shift 24x7 Factory model. The specific rota will be confirmed, but shift handovers are mandatory and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility.

descriptionFromApi:
About Enterpret

As the world moves to AI native applications, one element matters more than anything: the data. At Enterpret, we are unlocking the most impactful dataset for businesses, customer feedback. We centralize feedback across every source, like Twitter, Salesforce, Zendesk, Slack, Intercom, community forums, surveys, and Gong calls, into a single context graph. On top of it we build an adaptive taxonomy for each customer and an agent platform that lets teams query, monitor, and act on customer intelligence wherever they work, whether thats inside Enterpret, in Slack, or in their own AI tools through our MCP server.

Our customers include companies like Canva, Notion, WisprFlow, ElevenLabs, OpenRouter, Western Union, and several other Product Led Growth decacorns and F500 companies. We are backed by Kleiner Perkins, Peak XV Partners, and Unusual Ventures.

Our engineering culture is AI-native from the ground up. Agents, LLMs, and applied ML are not a side project here, they are the core of how we build. We work at the edge of what is possible in agentic systems and push past it.

About the Role

Every record in Enterprets context graph arrives through an integration. We ingest customer context from fifty plus sources, and from our customers own systems through our ingestion API.

This surface decides how accurate, complete, and fresh everything downstream is. It has been engineering-led so far. You will be the first product manager for the Integration Ecosystem, working with a dedicated engineering team and reporting into the product organization. You own two things: the experience of setting up and managing integrations, and the behavior of the system underneath.

You will think from first principles about how an enterprises customer context should reach Enterpret, and build a cohesive ingestion layer on top of the integrations we already have.

What You Will Do
  • Run the fleet like a portfolio. Fifty integrations, each built on a platform whose APIs, data models, and conventions keep moving. You will prioritize by revenue impact and error frequency, put the hard calls in writing, and decide which platforms the ecosystem integrates with next.
  • Own the system-behavior metrics for ingestion: completeness, latency, and error rates. You will define them, instrument them, and be measured on them.
  • Own the integration setup and management experience end to end: connecting a source, scoping exactly what gets ingested (filters, backfill windows, previews), and managing it over time.
  • Define per-integration error taxonomies, decide which failures customers see and which page our team, and ship proactive notifications so customers hear about issues from us first.
  • Build agent-first setup: an agent inspects the customers source, proposes the right configuration, and the customer reviews and confirms. You decide where a form still earns its place.
What It Takes
  • Direct product ownership of integrations, connectors, data ingestion, or API products on technical B2B surfaces. You have carried them through real platform change, like API deprecations, auth migrations, and breaking version upgrades.
  • Fluency in how platform APIs actually behave - auth flows, webhooks, rate limits, pagination, deprecation cycles - enough to hold your own in trade-off debates with engineers.
  • You have defined reliability and experience metrics where none existed, instrumented them, and moved them.
  • Comfort operating AI-first. Our default is that not using AI for a task is the choice that needs explaining.
What Success Looks Like

In 3 months: You own the problem inventory for the integration ecosystem, prioritized by revenue and error frequency. The highest-usage integration has a complete error taxonomy, and it is the template the rest of the fleet follows. Baselines exist for completeness, latency, and error rates.

In 6 months: Setup is self-serve for the majority of sources. Customers resolve the most common issues themselves, and notifications reach them before they notice a gap.

In 12 months: Every integration has a health standard and is measured against it. The fleet runs on a maintenance lifecycle with owned processes for API deprecations and source-platform changes. New integrations launch to the standard by default, and customers cite the setup experience as a reason they trust the product.

Why Enterpret
  • The problem: Fifty platforms that keep moving, and an ingestion layer every downstream agent depends on. It is a hard systems problem and an open product canvas, and you would be its first product manager.
  • Growth: Work directly with the Head of Product and engineering leadership at a Series-B company, with a dedicated engineering team on your surface.
  • Benefits: Competitive salary, equity, hybrid work, premium healthcare.
What We Value

At Enterpret, we operate with a deep sense of ownership. We play for the team and do what it takes to win together. We care personally for our teammates while pushing each other with honest, actionable feedback. Above all, we approach everything with humility and a drive to keep learning and getting better.

Equal Opportunities

We are an equal opportunity employer. We ensure that none of our employees or prospective employees receives less favourable treatment as a result of age, sex, disability, marital status, colour, race, religion or ethnic origin. Equally we aim to ensure that no such employee is disadvantaged by terms and conditions of employment which cannot be justified.

You will own meaningful modelling workstreams end-to-end, from problem formulation and experimentation through production deployment, monitoring, and iteration. You will work closely with the Staff Data Scientist, Planning Tools Engineering, and supply chain stakeholders across Bangalore and Palo Alto to translate complex operational challenges into scalable, measurable solutions.

You will also contribute to AI-native approaches to Operations Research and help establish strong scientific and engineering practices across the team.

Responsibilities

Operations Research & Modelling

  • Own meaningful modelling workstreams across areas such as dynamic warehouse routing, shipping cost optimization, multi-modal transportation, inventory placement, network flow, and PO allocation
  • Take ownership of problems end-to-end, from problem framing and data preparation through model development, deployment, and iteration
  • Translate operational challenges into well-defined optimization problems with clear objectives, constraints, and measurable success criteria
  • Apply appropriate Operations Research methodologies including Linear Programming (LP), Mixed-Integer Programming (MIP), Constraint Programming (CP), heuristics, vehicle routing, and network flow
  • Select and tune appropriate solvers and optimization approaches based on the characteristics of each problem
  • Run rigorous experiments and evaluate models against historical and operational data to ensure results are statistically and operationally meaningful

AI-Native Science

  • Evaluate AI-generated approaches alongside classical optimization methodologies based on measurable outcomes and scientific rigor
  • Validate AI-generated recommendations and hypotheses before incorporating them into production decision-making
  • Contribute to evolving team standards and best practices for applying AI effectively within Operations Research

Production & Engineering

  • Build and deploy models into production rather than limiting work to analytical prototypes or reports
  • Own the monitoring, performance evaluation, and iteration cycle for models after deployment
  • Develop and maintain feature pipelines, optimization workflows, and model-serving components
  • Partner with the Planning Tools Engineering team on solver integration, feature stores, evaluation frameworks, and model-serving infrastructure
  • Ensure models remain performant and reliable as supply chain networks, business conditions, and operational patterns evolve
  • Contribute to engineering best practices around reproducibility, testing, monitoring, and production model quality

Cross-Geography Collaboration

  • Work effectively across distributed teams and time zones with a strong emphasis on asynchronous communication

Business Partnership

  • Work directly with logistics, warehouse, and supply chain planning stakeholders to understand operational challenges

Qualifications

Position: AI/ML Engineer (Gen AI)

Location: Nagpur | Pune | Bangalore

Purpose of the Position:

The AI/ML Engineer (Generative AI) - G4 role focuses on developing, implementing, and supporting generative AI and machine learning solutions under the guidance of senior engineers and architects. The role is primarily an individual contributor position, responsible for building models, experimenting with GenAI techniques, supporting deployments, and contributing to AI solutions that address business requirements.

This role emphasizes hands - on model development, prompt engineering, integration support, and continuous learning, with exposure to LLMs, retrieval - augmented generation (RAG), and AI pipelines within enterprise environments. The engineer will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and cloud teams to deliver reliable AI features while adhering to security, governance, and quality standards defined by the organization.

InfoCepts is a global leader of end-to-end data and analytics solutions with nearly 20 years experience enabling customers to derive value from a variety of data-driven capabilities. Unique among its peers, InfoCepts operates with the scale of a global consulting firm, yet the expertise of a niche partner.

At InfoCepts, you ll be challenged to think innovatively, while growing your own personal and professional skills designed with the future in mind. We have more than 1200 global professionals working on cutting edge technology solutions with a single mission - transforming our customers journey with data-driven modernization.

  • InfoCepts has been recognized as Gartner Peer Insights Customers Choice for two consecutive years in 2020 and 2021 which recognizes our best-in-class services that help our customers approach any data analytics problem.
  • We are certified by Great Place to Work , India in 2021 and recognizes our high-trust and high-performance work culture, and great employee experience in the industry.
  • Our award-winning reusable solutions approach is well recognized in the D&A industry and lets our associates leverage our collective and proven consultative expertise, accelerate solution delivery through automation, enable faster time to value with reusable toolkits - all while delivering exceptional customer experience.

Our success has been unique, and we are looking for professionals who are enthusiastic and passionate about data & analytics, delivering differentiated experiences, and solving real world problems for our global customers. This position works with the competency and delivery team to execute on the assigned responsibilities.

Key Result Areas (KRAs):

Model Development & Implementation

  • Develop and fine-tune machine learning and generative AI models using established frameworks and best practices.
  • Assist in implementing LLM-based solutions under defined architectures and guidelines.
  • Support model training, evaluation, and validation activities.

Prompt Engineering & LLM Usage

  • Design and refine prompts for LLM-based applications to improve output relevance and accuracy.
  • Assist in testing and evaluating generated responses against defined quality metrics.
  • Work with APIs and foundation models as per solution requirements.

Data Preparation & Handling

  • Perform data preprocessing, transformation, and validation for structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Ensure data quality and consistency during model development and testing phases.

Integration & Support

  • Support integration of AI/ML models into applications and workflows in collaboration with software engineering teams.
  • Assist in deploying models using existing CI/CD and MLOps pipelines.
  • Participate in troubleshooting model or application issues.

Continuous Learning & Improvement

  • Stay updated with advancements in machine learning and generative AI.
  • Contribute to knowledge sharing, documentation, and technical discussions within the team.

Essential Skills:

  • Python Programming: Working proficiency in Python for AI/ML development using libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras.
  • Machine Learning Fundamentals: Understanding of core ML concepts including supervised/unsupervised learning, model evaluation, and basic deep learning principles.
  • Generative AI & LLM Basics: Exposure to large language models, prompt engineering, and LLM usage via APIs.
  • Model Training & Evaluation: Experience in training, fine-tuning, and evaluating ML models with guidance from senior team members.

  • Problem Solving: Ability to analyze problems and implement solutions under defined technical direction.
  • Collaboration Skills: Capability to work effectively with cross-functional teams including data scientists, engineers, and analysts.

Desirable Skills:

  • Basic understanding of Retrieval - Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts.
  • Exposure to vector databases and embeddings.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for AI workloads.

The Mechanical Engineering Department Manager is a senior leadership role responsible for the overall performance, technical integrity, capability, and development of the Mechanical Engineering function.

The role encompasses technical governance, project delivery, resource and talent management, operational excellence, business support, and transformation.

  • Act as the senior escalation point for significant technical issues and engineering risks.
  • Establish and maintain engineering procedures, standards, best practices, and technical assurance requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with company practices, project requirements, applicable codes and standards, and client specifications.
  • Lead or support critical design reviews, technical audits, risk assessments, and assurance activities.
  • Promote engineering quality, technical integrity, standardization, lessons learned, and knowledge sharing.

  • Oversee engineering activities across Static, Rotating, and Packaged Equipment.
  • Support Project Managers and Engineering Managers in achieving safety, quality, schedule, cost, and productivity objectives.
  • Ensure projects are appropriately resourced and Mechanical Engineering deliverables are executed to required quality and schedule.
  • Monitor departmental project performance and proactively resolve technical, resource, quality, and delivery challenges.
  • Facilitate resolution of complex engineering issues and multidisciplinary interfaces.
  • Maintain departmental accountability for engineering quality and technical integrity.

3. Resource, Talent & Capability Management

  • Optimize deployment of resources across projects and monitor utilization and project chargeability.
  • Maintain appropriate resource capability to respond to current and emerging project requirements.
  • Recruit, develop, mentor, and retain high-performing engineering personnel.
  • Identify competency gaps and implement appropriate technical, digital, and leadership development.
  • Establish succession plans for key leadership, Technical Authority, and specialist positions.
  • Manage personnel, performance, and organizational challenges effectively.

4. Operational Excellence & Transformation

  • Monitor departmental KPIs and implement improvement actions where required.
  • Drive continuous improvement in engineering quality, productivity, standardization, and execution efficiency.
  • Promote adoption of digital engineering, automation, data-driven solutions, and AI-enabled workflows where they improve engineering performance.
  • Encourage innovation, reuse of proven engineering solutions, and implementation of lessons learned.
  • Lead or support engineering, digital, and organizational transformation initiatives.

5. Business & Organizational Leadership

  • Support proposals, estimates, resource plans, execution strategies, risk reviews, and business development activities.
  • Participate in client meetings, technical presentations, and project readiness reviews as required.
  • Maintain effective relationships with Project Management, Engineering disciplines, Operations, clients, vendors, and global engineering centres.
  • Represent the Mechanical Engineering Department in management, project, technical, and client forums.
  • Make timely decisions balancing technical integrity, safety, quality, schedule, cost, resources, and business risk.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, continuous learning, and professional development.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor s degree in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized university.
  • Minimum 20 years of relevant engineering experience, preferably in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Refining, LNG, Offshore, Energy, or related process industries.
  • Strong hands-on design and engineering experience in at least one core area: Static Equipment, Rotating Equipment, or Packaged Equipment Systems.
  • Broad understanding of Mechanical Engineering disciplines sufficient to provide department-level technical leadership.
  • Significant experience in engineering leadership, technical assurance, resource management, and multidisciplinary EPC/EPCM project execution.
  • Experience in FEED and/or Detailed Engineering of major projects is preferred.
  • Experience managing sizeable engineering teams and multiple concurrent projects is highly desirable.

Key Leadership Competencies

  • Strong technical credibility and engineering judgement.

  • Effective resource and talent management.
  • Strong project delivery and commercial awareness.

  • Commitment to safety, quality, technical integrity, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

descriptionFromApi:
Job Purpose:

The Domain Architect Automation & Integration is responsible for defining and governing architecture standards, reference patterns, and integration approaches within the automation domain across UiPath execution environments, ERP/workflow platforms (Odoo/BR Connect), and API-driven integrations.

The role provides system-level design guidance to ensure automation solutions are scalable, modular, interoperable, secure, audit-ready, and cost-effective across multiple clients and heterogeneous EMR/PMS environments. The Architect drives consistency through pragmatic standards and reusable frameworks, and partners with delivery teams, platform engineering, security, and operations to reduce risk and improve speed of execution.

This is a platform architecture and technical leadership role (not a primary “build every bot” role).

---

Key Responsibilities:

1. Automation Domain Architecture

1. Define target-state automation domain architecture and integration patterns across UiPath, ERP/workflow systems, and API integrations.

2. Establish and maintain architectural standards, reusable templates, reference frameworks, and modular design principles (e.g., configuration, exception taxonomy, logging schema).

3. Define centralized observability standards (logging, metrics, traceability, alerts) and ensure automation telemetry supports operational and audit requirements.

4. Define architecture review checkpoints, quality gates, and lifecycle standards for automations (intake assessment design build test release monitoring), in alignment with the broader delivery governance model.

5. Publish and maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and reference designs to reduce ambiguity and prevent “snowflake” implementations.

---

2. Workflow & ERP Integration


1. Architect deep integration patterns between automation platforms and Odoo (BR Connect) to enable workflow-native automation.

2. Define event-driven triggers and workflow patterns (e.g., status transitions, queues, webhooks, scheduled triggers) that scale across clients and departments.

3. Ensure alignment between business process intent and technical implementation by translating process goals into system workflows, data contracts, and automation patterns.

4. Standardize integration mechanisms between internal systems and external platforms (EMR/PMS, payer portals, clearinghouse interfaces), including data validation and error recovery patterns.

---

3. Orchestration & Control Strategy

1. Define reference orchestration approaches (UiPath Orchestrator / hybrid / custom control plane) and guardrails, aligned to operational constraints and platform direction.

2. Establish workload distribution standards across execution environments (server pools, VM/terminal servers, cloud access constraints), including queue strategy and priority rules.

3. Define capacity planning standards (robot concurrency, scheduling windows, SLA-based throughput) and partner with operations/engineering to implement scalable execution models as demand grows.

4. Define the automation performance tracking and SLA monitoring framework (availability, success rate, throughput, MTTR) and align reporting/escalation processes with operations and support teams.

5. Provide architectural input to licensing and cost-scaling decisions (capacity triggers, utilization signals, ROI assumptions) to support delivery without creating bottlenecks.

---

4. API & System Integration Governance

1. Design and review RESTful integrations and integration contracts (schemas, idempotency, retry strategy, error codes, versioning).

2. Promote an API-first integration strategy and reduce fragile UI automation where APIs or data interfaces are feasible.

3. Architect secure authentication and authorization patterns (OAuth2, token handling, secrets rotation), including credential vault integration and least-privilege access.

4. Ensure interoperability across EMR, ERP/workflow, automation platforms, and external systems with audit-ready traceability and controlled data flows.

---

5. Python & Service Framework Oversight


1. Provide architectural guidance for Python-based automation services (e.g., OCR/document processing, data transformation utilities, integration services), ensuring clear interfaces, operational readiness, maintainability, and measurable quality targets.

2. Establish standards for logging, exception handling, monitoring, deployment, scaling, and secure configuration management for services.

3. Ensure service-oriented design principles are followed (separation of concerns, clear APIs, versioning, resilience, testing strategy).

---

6. AI-assisted Automation & Intelligent Workflows

1. Define how AI-assisted automation can be introduced safely through concrete patterns (human-in-the-loop approvals, confidence thresholds, fallbacks, audit logs) and clear integration boundaries between AI services and automation workflows.

2. Establish reusable workflow primitives/components (classification, routing, triage, exception enrichment) that can be adopted consistently across use cases.

3. Partner with the AI team to define governance patterns for AI-assisted automation (confidence thresholds, human-in-the-loop approvals, monitoring, prompt/version control where applicable).

4. Enable adoption of AI-assisted automation enhancements aligned with measurable business outcomes (TAT, accuracy, denials reduction, productivity) in partnership with delivery and operations teams.

---

7. Technical Leadership & Governance

1. Facilitate architecture design reviews, technical decision forums, and cross-team alignment (RPA, BA, Internal Platform, IT/Infrastructure, Operations).

2. Define and drive adoption of automation domain best practices and solution design standards (coding standards, review checklists, release readiness criteria) while keeping governance lightweight and enabling delivery speed.

3. Mentor UiPath and Python teams through enablement (templates, reference implementations, review checklists, coaching).

4. Collaborate with Infrastructure and Security teams to ensure environments meet compliance/security requirements (PHI/PII, access control, logging policies, retention).

5. Partner with leadership to translate automation domain goals into phased reference architectures and adoption plans with measurable outcomes and risk management.

6. Clarify role boundaries and build team autonomy: architect enables and governs—delivery teams execute.

---

Skills and Competencies:

1. Strong system-level thinking with ability to design scalable, modular, secure, and operable automation domain architectures.

2. Deep understanding of automation platforms and integration patterns (queues, orchestration, event-driven workflows, APIs).

3. Strong knowledge of UiPath (Studio, Orchestrator concepts, REFramework, best practices, exception handling, logging).

4. Working knowledge of Python-based services and API integration patterns; able to review designs and guide engineering standards (hands-on development is a plus).

5. Experience integrating ERP/workflow platforms (Odoo preferred) and designing workflow-driven automations.

6. Strong understanding of REST API design, interoperability, and reliability patterns (idempotency, retries, versioning).

7. Knowledge of orchestration strategies and distributed execution models (UiPath Orchestrator concepts preferred).

8. Strong security mindset: secrets management, credential vault integration, least privilege, audit logging, compliance-aligned access controls.

9. Excellent documentation and architectural modeling capability (reference architectures, ADRs, runbooks).

10. Strong problem-solving skills with ability to prioritize pragmatic solutions over over-engineering.

11. Strong communication skills with both technical teams and business stakeholders.

12. Ability to challenge legacy patterns constructively and drive adoption through enablement, not micromanagement.

---

Qualifications:

1. 7-10+ years of experience in automation architecture, system integration, platform engineering, or similar roles (or equivalent demonstrated capability).

2. Minimum 3+ years hands-on experience in UiPath automation (architecture/design, governance, and best practices).

3. Experience with Python and API-based integrations (ability to collaborate with service engineers, review designs, and ensure operability/security).

4. Experience working with ERP/workflow platforms (Odoo preferred) and cross-system integration.

5. Exposure to orchestration platforms and distributed system design (UiPath Orchestrator or equivalent concepts).

6. Experience in healthcare/RCM domain is an advantage (PHI/PII handling, audit readiness, client IT coordination).

7. UiPath certifications and/or Cloud/Integration certifications are preferred.

---

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

1. Architecture Adoption & Quality Rate: % of automation initiatives aligned with defined standards and passing architecture review checkpoints.

2. Reusability Index: Adoption rate and measurable impact of reusable components/templates (reduced build time, reduced defects).

3. Integration Stability: Reduction in integration-related incidents; improved reliability of API and workflow integrations.

4. Scalability & Capacity Governance: Demonstrated ability to scale workloads within defined SLA windows using capacity planning and orchestration strategy.

5. Governance Effectiveness: Timeliness and quality of architecture artifacts (ADRs, reference patterns, roadmaps) without creating delivery bottlenecks.

6. Innovation Enablement: Delivery of phased enhancements aligned with automation domain priorities (e.g., orchestration adoption, AI-assisted patterns) with measurable business outcomes.

jobDescription:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
We are looking for a Senior Automation Engineer to design and scale intelligent automation across Oktas Enterprise Technology ecosystem. This role will reduce manual operational work, improve developer productivity, and accelerate the software delivery lifecycle across platforms such as Salesforce, NetSuite, AEM, Boomi, identity systems, CI/CD platforms, and other enterprise applications.
The engineer will build reliable automation services, reusable integration patterns, and AI-assisted developer agents that understand source code, metadata, configuration, tickets, documentation, deployment history, and operational context. These solutions will automate release activities, identify deployment risks, reduce merge-conflict resolution effort, improve environment management, and enable safe self-service operations.
The role requires a combination of software engineering, enterprise application expertise, API and integration development, CI/CD automation, security engineering, and practical experience applying AI to developer and operational workflows. The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between platform-specific technologies and building scalable, secure, platform-agnostic automation frameworks.
What you\'ll be doing Intelligent Automation and Developer Productivity
  • Build AI-assisted developer agents and automation services that reduce repetitive engineering and operational work.
  • Use contextual information from Git repositories, metadata, tickets, documentation, deployment logs, and platform APIs to make automation more accurate and useful.
  • Automate release planning, validation, dependency analysis, testing, deployment coordination, post-release verification, and rollback activities.
  • Build tools that detect potential merge conflicts, explain their impact, and recommend or execute safe resolutions with appropriate human approval.
  • Develop agents that assist with code and metadata analysis, documentation, test generation, troubleshooting, incident response, and operational runbooks.
  • Establish metrics to measure productivity gains, manual effort reduction, deployment quality, and automation adoption.
Cross-Platform Enterprise Automation
  • Design and implement automation across Salesforce, NetSuite, AEM, Boomi, Okta, GitHub, CI/CD systems, ticketing platforms, and other ET applications.
  • Build reusable APIs, connectors, scripts, workflows, and event-driven services.
  • Create platform-agnostic automation patterns for authentication, authorization, retries, error handling, logging, monitoring, and auditability.
  • Develop self-service capabilities that allow teams to safely perform approved tasks without direct manual intervention.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve end-to-end workflows spanning multiple enterprise applications.
Salesforce Platform Engineering and Security
  • Design and optimize Salesforce Flows, declarative automation, Apex utilities, and platform integrations.
  • Implement Profiles, Permission Sets, Permission Set Groups, FLS, Sharing Rules, OWDs, Shield, Event Monitoring, and related security controls.
  • Build data masking and lower-environment protection processes for sensitive information.
  • Debug and refactor platform automation to improve reliability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Review third-party packages, Connected Apps, OAuth configurations, and API access in partnership with Security and Privacy teams.
Release, CI/CD, and Environment Automation
  • Eliminate manual deployment and environment-management steps through automation.
  • Build CI/CD integrations for metadata validation, testing, deployment, approvals, and rollback.
  • Automate sandbox refreshes, data masking, metadata synchronization, configuration updates, and post-refresh activities.
  • Maintain automation code and configuration in GitHub using appropriate branching, testing, review, and release practices.
  • Partner with Release Engineering and DevSecOps teams to standardize deployment and operational patterns
Automation Security, Governance, and Reliability
  • Implement least-privilege access for service accounts, agents, integrations, and automation workflows.
  • Apply guardrails and human approval controls to high-risk actions.
  • Protect sensitive data used by automation and AI systems.
  • Maintain comprehensive execution logs, audit trails, monitoring, and alerting.
  • Design for reliability through testing, idempotency, retries, failure recovery, and rollback.
  • Establish governance standards for secure and responsible use of AI-enabled automation
Required Qualifications
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise automation, platform engineering, DevOps, integration engineering, or a related field.
  • Proven experience building production-grade automation that reduces manual operational or development work.
  • Strong programming experience in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, Java, or a similar language.
  • Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, event-driven workflows, asynchronous processing, and SaaS integrations.
  • Experience with Git/GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, release engineering, and environment management.
  • Experience with at least two enterprise platforms, preferably including Salesforce, NetSuite, AEM, Boomi, Okta, or comparable systems.
  • Hands-on Salesforce experience with Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Flows, Salesforce CLI, metadata APIs, and platform security.
  • Experience designing reusable automation frameworks, internal tools, CLI utilities, or developer platforms.
  • Practical experience integrating LLMs or AI services into enterprise workflows, developer tools, or operational automation.
  • Understanding of agentic workflows, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation, context management, and human-in-the-loop automation.
  • Experience implementing security controls for APIs, service accounts, connected applications, secrets, data access, and automation infrastructure.
  • Strong debugging, documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Salesforce Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Platform Developer I certification.
  • Experience with Salesforce Shield, Event Monitoring, security audits, or data masking.
  • Experience with NetSuite, AEM, Boomi, Okta, ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, or similar enterprise platforms.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI or comparable CI/CD technologies.
  • Experience with cloud services such as AWS or GCP, including serverless functions, queues, secrets management, and observability.
  • Experience with agent frameworks, LLM APIs, vector databases, RAG systems, or AI evaluation frameworks.
  • Experience building developer agents for code review, release engineering, incident management, testing, or platform operations.
  • Experience working in a large, geographically distributed enterprise environment.

descriptionFromApi:
This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Actions technical partner in India.
About EAII
EAII Advisors, Evidence Action s technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families. For more information, read about our work here: About Evidence Action and EAII
About Evidence Action
At Evidence Action, we deliver data-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we re making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 9 countries, our team of 800+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
  • Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
  • Through Safe Water Now, we ve saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
  • Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.
.
The Role
Our Accelerator is the engine for new programs. It is a venture-style, stage-gated pipeline that finds the most promising health interventions and develops the strongest into programs ready to scale. Only about 2% of the interventions we evaluate make it through, and those that do have gone on to raise over $100 million. The New Program Development (NPD) team drives this work. We source and vet new ideas, dig into the evidence and cost-effectiveness, build partnerships with researchers, governments, and implementers, and test concepts in the field to turn the best ideas into real programs.
We are hiring a Principal Manager to lead the development of our next generation of health programs. You will own a set of early-stage interventions and drive each one from a research insight to a program that is proven, fundable, and ready to scale, or to a clear and well-reasoned decision to stop. You bring the rigor of an analyst who can interrogate evidence honestly and reason carefully under uncertainty. You also bring the drive of a builder who can source opportunities, cultivate partnerships, and turn ideas into programs that work in the real world. Together, those strengths let you find and build the interventions that deliver the most health impact for every dollar spent. You will join a close-knit team that puts evidence first, thinks big, acts urgently, and is willing to challenge convention to reach more people. You will report to the India Country Lead with a dotted technical line to the Accelerator Director.
Responsibilities
  • Own a portfolio of pipeline interventions, end to end. Drive several promising candidate programs through the Accelerators stage-gate process, and decide what advances, what gets reshaped, and what exits our pipeline.
  • Interrogate the evidence with honesty. Assess each interventions evidence base on the merits, including effect sizes and their quality, external validity, variability, negative and contradictory findings, and gaps.
  • Model impact and cost-effectiveness under uncertainty. Partner with the Cost-Effectiveness team to build and pressure-test CEAs, reasoning explicitly about assumptions, sensitivity, and uncertainty, and translating them into clear go/no-go implications.
  • Design and run decision-relevant learning in close collaboration with our MLE team. Scope and execute lean, rigorous field activities such as scoping, formative research, and pilots, to unblock decisions.
  • Build the case and align stakeholders. Craft compelling, evidence-grounded investment cases. Bring researchers, implementers, governments, and donors along, anticipate objections, unblock barriers, and create momentum.
  • Collaborate across Evidence Action. Work hand in hand with our Growth team to build necessary resourcing and funding, relevant Program teams who bring the implementation muscle, and the Country Teams who cultivate and manage the policy and government partnerships in the places we work.
  • Be Evidence Actions face with partners. Independently lead conversations with study authors, implementing organizations, government officials, and funders, and use those relationships to source new ideas and partnerships.
  • Strengthen the Accelerators methods, AI-enabled workflows, and quality bar, and mentor analysts and interns on the workstreams you lead.
Essential
  • You have a bachelors degree and 6 - 10 years of experience in quant social science, program management, international development, or global health in a cross-country setting.
  • You read primary research and study design critically, synthesize large and conflicting evidence bases, and form an honest view of what the evidence does and does not support.
  • You build or rigorously interpret cost-effectiveness, epidemiological, or statistical models, and reason clearly about assumptions, sensitivity, and uncertainty.
  • You design lean learning activities that target the uncertainty actually blocking a decision, and you deliver them on a timeline.
  • You move things forward amid uncertainty, building, prototyping, and unblocking rather than waiting for perfect information.
  • You build trust and align both internal teams and external partners (researchers, implementers, government, and donors) across cultures and sectors toward a shared path.
  • You make complex technical findings clear and decision-useful for non-technical audiences, in writing and live.
  • You manage several workstreams at once, sequence sharply, and make defensible calls about where to spend scarce time.
  • You have experience working in an international setting and working with diverse teams.
  • You look for the reasons your favorite idea might be wrong, and welcome the same scrutiny of your own work.

descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary
Come join our engineering team in a hands-on technical role at the heart of a new discipline: Harness Engineering. As AI coding agents take on more of the software lifecycle, the hard part is no longer writing code - agents generate it faster than humans can review it, so the bottleneck shifts to verification and trust. Harness Engineering exists to break that bottleneck: engineering the environment that steers agents toward correct, maintainable, well-architected output so that quality is enforced by the system, not re-audited by a person on every change. We call that environment the harness (Agent = Model + Harness). As a Lead Harness Engineer youll build and own the individual controls that make up that harness, working end-to-end from problem to production.
Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, deploy, and support components of the harness - the guides, feedback loops, guardrails, and shared context that turn raw model capability into production-grade engineering. This is a hands-on role focused on systems and leverage, not hand-writing application code.
  • Build feedforward guides - agent instruction files, reusable skills, architectural rules, reference docs, and codemods - that help agents get it right the first time.
  • Build feedback sensors - custom linters, static analysis, structural and architecture-fitness tests, verification loops, and LLM-as-judge reviewers - that catch issues before they reach human reviewers.
  • Run the steering loop - when an agent repeats a mistake, engineer a control so it cant happen again - and help keep repository knowledge (docs, specs, context) legible to agents, fighting drift.
  • Contribute to quality gating and release criteria, and to LLM testing that ensures AI-generated output meets quality and safety thresholds.
  • Help improve observability into agent work and track the measures that matter - cost per merged PR, time-to-merge for agent-assisted PRs, review velocity relative to PR size, defect escape rate, and agent-PR survival rate.
  • Evaluate the stability, compatibility, scalability, interoperability, and performance of harness components.
  • Continually learn new techniques in agent-augmented engineering, and serve as a source of technical expertise and mentor to junior team members.
Requirements
  • Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science or related disciplines, or relevant experience in software architecture, design, development, and testing.
  • Strong software engineering background; youve worked in large codebases and care about architecture, testing, and maintainability.
  • Comfortable building tooling across a modern stack - linters and static analysis, CI pipelines, containerized build/test environments, and instrumentation/observability - and familiar with agent instruction conventions such as Agents.md.
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, or similar) and a feel for where they succeed and fail.
  • Experience with spec-driven development, context engineering, agent orchestration, fitness functions, and developer-platform work.
  • A systems mindset - youd rather fix the environment than fix one output - and the ability to encode "what good looks like" into mechanical, repeatable rules.
  • Judgement about when to reach for deterministic, computational controls (type checkers, linters, structural/architecture-fitness tests) versus inferential, LLM-based ones (AI code review, LLM-as-judge) - and an understanding of the cost, speed, and reliability trade-offs between them.
  • Clear communicator; able to articulate design with architects and discuss strategy and requirements with teams.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) and digital health technologies are transforming healthcare by enabling innovative solutions that enhance health system efficiency, service delivery, and patient outcomes, contributing to the achievement of Universal Health Coverage (UHC) and the health-related Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
The Government of Chhattisgarh has formally requested WHO-SEARO's technical support to develop and implement a roadmap for UHC and health-related SDGs in the state. This collaboration was advanced through the Joint Consultative Meeting for the Development and Implementation of UHC and Health SDG Roadmaps in Chhattisgarh and Madhya Pradesh (Bhopal, April 2026) and the Swasth Chhattisgarh Consultation (Raipur, June 2026). Intelehealth is supporting the Government of Chhattisgarh and WHO-SEARO in operationalising telemedicine, digital health, and AI interventions in the state, including under an Agreement for Performance of Work (APW) with WHO. The Senior Digital Health AI Project Coordinator will be Intelehealth's dedicated in-state resource, based in Raipur, to coordinate digital health and AI interventions across Chhattisgarh - including AI evaluations and digital health innovations - working in close collaboration with WHO-SEARO's Digital Health team and the Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of Chhattisgarh. descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary

Come join our engineering team to build the discipline that lets AI coding agents do reliable work at scale. As agents take on more of the software lifecycle, the hard part is no longer writing code - agents generate it faster than humans can review it, so the bottleneck shifts to verification and trust. Harness Engineering exists to break that bottleneck: engineering the environment that steers agents toward correct, maintainable, well-architected output so that quality is enforced by the system, not re-audited by a person on every change. We call that environment the harness (Agent = Model + Harness). This is a hands-on management role: you will personally build harness components while leading and growing a team of harness engineers and governing the responsible use of AI across your team.

What You'll Contribute

  • Personally design, build, deploy, and support components of the harness - the guides, feedback loops, guardrails, and shared context that turn raw model capability into production-grade engineering. This is a hands-on role; you will contribute code, not just direct it.
  • Build and maintain feedforward guides (agent instruction files, reusable skills, architectural rules, reference docs, and codemods) and feedback sensors (custom linters, architecture-fitness tests, verification loops, and LLM-as-judge reviewers) that help agents get it right the first time and catch issues before they reach human reviewers.
  • Drive adoption of AI coding agents and harness practices through hands-on enablement - pairing, office hours, and reference examples - measuring success by active usage, review time saved, and defect escape rate rather than by artifacts shipped.
  • Govern responsible AI usage within your team, ensuring engineers apply AI tools appropriately, ethically, and in line with company standards, compliance requirements, and defined quality and safety thresholds.
  • Own quality gating and release criteria for your teams work - defining authority boundaries for what agents may merge unaided and the escalation rules for what must route to a human.
  • Run the steering loop - when agents repeat a class of mistake, ensure a control is engineered so it cant happen again - and keep repository knowledge (docs, specs, context) legible to agents, fighting drift continuously.
  • Track and act on the measures that matter - cost per merged PR, time-to-merge for agent-assisted PRs, review velocity relative to PR size, defect escape rate, and agent-PR survival rate.
  • Coordinate day-to-day activities and direct team members; monitor performance, and provide coaching, counseling, and motivation to maximise contribution.
  • Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to attract talent, set goals, and measure and reward performance.
  • Serve as a source of technical expertise, including guidance on the effective and responsible use of AI tools.

What Were Seeking

  • Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science or related discipline, or relevant experience in software design, development, and testing.
  • Strong software engineering background in large, complex codebases, with genuine care for architecture, testing, and maintainability - you remain hands-on.
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, or similar) and a well-developed feel for where they succeed and fail.
  • Experience building engineering tooling across a modern stack - linters and static analysis, CI/CD pipelines, containerized build/test environments, and instrumentation/observability - plus familiarity with agent instruction conventions such as AGENTS.md.
  • Experience with spec-driven development, context engineering, agent orchestration, fitness functions, and developer-platform work.
  • A systems mindset - youd rather fix the environment than fix one output - and the ability to encode what good looks like into mechanical, repeatable rules.
  • Judgement about when to reach for deterministic, computational controls (type checkers, linters, structural/architecture-fitness tests) versus inferential, LLM-based ones (AI code review, LLM-as-judge) - and an understanding of the cost, speed, and reliability trade-offs between them.
  • Strong people management experience with the proven ability to manage a high-performing team, including navigating the organisational change that AI adoption brings.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive AI adoption within a team while governing responsible use, managing associated risks, and maintaining compliance awareness.
  • Working knowledge of the security surface unique to autonomous agents - prompt injection, tool/permission scoping, sandboxed execution, and audit trails for agent actions - and how to design least-privilege guardrails around them.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code as they relate to managing modern engineering teams.
  • Excellent communication skills to articulate design, strategy, and standards across teams.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

Sr Financial Analyst, Assurant - India

The Senior Financial Analyst supports the Finance department by delivering independent and thorough financial research, analysis, and insights. The role evaluates complex information to identify key performance drivers and provides clear, data-based recommendations. This position is responsible for producing accurate and timely financial analysis that supports departmental objectives and informs sound business decisions.

This position will be in Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Chennai at our India location.

Work Hours - 3:30 PM - 12:30 AM IST (Evening Shift)

Responsibilities

  • Provide data, analysis and insight to support decision making by senior management.
  • Primary contributor in the development of monthly and quarterly financial reviews, preparing reports and presentations for senior management.
  • Perform a deep-dive analysis of budget, actuals, forecasts and develop insights for delivery to senior leadership.
  • Create and maintain economic models for analysis purposes and preparation of business plans, reporting, research, and analysis for internal customers on a monthly, quarterly, and ad-hoc basis.
  • Take a key role in coordinating and managing the annual budgeting process, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
  • Prepare and present special projects providing technical and financial support to facilitate the achievement of management objectives.
  • Take on complex data analysis projects and prepare reports for senior leadership as needed.
  • Identify and recommend opportunities for continuous process improvement.
  • Conduct ad hoc financial analysis and special reporting as requested by business management; develop insights and recommendations to address specific financial challenges.

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or Information Systems.

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in financial analysis, including budgeting, forecasting, and data interpretation.

Skills Competencies

  • Competent in reviewing financial statements, identifying key business value drivers, and developing projected financial data.
  • Understanding of how economic trends, political situations, policies, and regulations may affect business results.
  • Strong general business knowledge to produce relevant research.
  • Excellent communication and people skills to effectively work with other departments.
  • Strong writing and presentation skills with the ability to distill and articulate complex concepts in an easily understood fashion.
  • Initiative-taking self-starter ready to hit the ground running.
  • Able to process complex time-sensitive data and information from multiple sources, make decisions based on this data, and effectively communicate the related actions to a broad audience.
  • Ability to face situations that are unstructured and require original approaches.
  • Strong organizational, time management, problem solving and analytical skills.

Technology Requirements

  • Advanced data analysis skills to structure/create data sets and synthesize information using Microsoft Excel and other financial tools.
  • SQL Server, Power BI reporting Alteryx experience a plus.

Preferred Experience, Skills, and Knowledge

  • Experience with activity-based costing or resource tracking methodologies.
  • Familiarity with financial systems such as SAP, Oracle, or similar ERP platforms.
  • Experience working in a shared services or multi-site operational environment.
  • Knowledge of financial reporting standards and variance analysis.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate across departments.
  • Experience supporting international operations or working in a global organization.

jobDescription:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Senior Real Time Developer

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience as a C/C++ Software Engineer.

  • Experience in multi-threaded Performance-Oriented programming.

  • Ability to quickly get into a large and complex code base.

  • Experience in OOP.

  • Initiative and Independent with self-learning capabilities.

  • Team player with good interpersonal skills.

  • Experience with at least one of the following:

  • Knowledge of Linux and network programming.

  • Background in TLS, HTTP/S, Web Security, Application Firewall, Denial of Service, etc.

  • B.Sc. in Computer Science or a parallel degree from an academic establishment.

Advantage:

  • Knowledge of layer 2-4 network protocols such as TCP, IP, ARP, etc.

  • Cloud native experience / understanding of AWS public cloud.

  • eBPF/gRPC programming.

  • Experience with OpenSSL.

At Thales, we re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference - for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.
